root_cause_found_20261020.summary: Two independent context factors made every modified run fail tvE while the baselines passed. Both are now identified and fixed; the fixes reproduce the baseline output bit-for-bit.

factor_1_pe_row_order.mechanism: The sharded stage-2 merge concatenated parquet rows in shard order, changing the PE row order. FullReader's stable sort (sort_values on max_z_length) breaks ties by row order, so block membership changed -> different padded tensor widths -> different float32 execution -> chains diverged beyond 1e-6 (~2-3/100 events).
factor_1_pe_row_order.proof: testR (job 1333591, g0059 gpu:1): rewrote the merged PE into the single-process row order and ran stage-3 only -> output BITWISE IDENTICAL to the baseline archive (0/100 events differ).

factor_2_cpu_count.mechanism: gpu:2 jobs default to 16 CPUs; the reference-matching context is the gpu:1 default of 8 CPUs. The stage-3 signature differs between them.
factor_2_cpu_count.proof: testC (job 1333592, g0059 gpu:2 + --cpus-per-task=8): output == the gpu:1-direct signature (byte-identical size 3,880,449 and comparator-equal to single.h5)

root_cause_found_20261020.ruled_out: CVD visibility (cvdA==cvdB), run.py cache env (envrep==single), node (on590c==on500c==single across g0059/g0050/g0087), stage-3 sharding code path (SJ_RECON_SHARDS=1 default)
fixes: fsmp.py: sharded workers now write ONE parquet per part; the parent merges part files in ascending part order -> exact single-process row order (canonical)
submit.sh: SJ_CPUS (default 8) forces --cpus-per-task=8 for every submission, restoring the reference-matching CPU context regardless of GPU count
